stem: What is the most defensible interpretation of faster sampling in this lecture?

options.text: Shorter update intervals improve the accuracy of uncertain mass parameters even if those parameters are not reidentified
The continuous-time design may be reused at any new rate without checking discrete implementation effects
Repeating one stored sensor reading at several faster cycles supplies a new physical measurement at each cycle
Shorter update intervals can reduce sampling-related approximation error, but gains and delays still need assessment

stem: Under the slide’s homogeneous-error approximation, why need diagonal K_p and K_v not decouple the joints?

options.text: The products equal K_pM⁻¹ and K_vM⁻¹, so each original coordinate is automatically independent
The full products M⁻¹K_p and M⁻¹K_v can retain off-diagonal entries
Only the diagonal entries of M⁻¹ participate when the right-hand factor is diagonal
The off-diagonal entries cancel because the same M⁻¹ multiplies both gain matrices
